contract.display_mode: NGA deprecated: no effect; returns the system display mode, not a KErrNone success result.
contract.alpha: Enables window alpha; returns KErrNone or a system error. Invalid areas clear to background before drawing; transparent background is required for this hole-punch use.

compositor_policy: An opened visible native video disables EGL page composition, tears down its window surface, invalidates the full bitmap and paints the software hole path. No simultaneous GPU-page/MMF alpha composition claim.
